verdict.rationale: Sketch documents use an open .sketch format (zipped JSON + binary assets), which supports data portability and export, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive 'export everything and leave' workflow (e.g., bulk export of all workspace data, comments, version history, libraries) or documented data-portability/GDPR export tooling. missing for 10: bulk/workspace-wide data export tooling, documentation of exporting comments/version history/libraries, third-party confirmation of lock-in-free migration, explicit 'leave and take your data' guarantees.
